rights_decision.basis: The exact upstream BSD-3-Clause text permits redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, subject to notice and non-endorsement conditions. The project therefore admits these exact pinned objects for model-training use. Public availability alone is not the basis. Because upstream states that Django includes some Python-standard-library-derived code without mapping that notice to every file, redistributed evidence retains both LICENSE and LICENSE.python as a conservative compliance boundary.
redistribution_obligations: Retain the Django copyright notice, BSD-3-Clause conditions, and disclaimer with source redistribution.
For binary or transformed redistribution, reproduce the Django copyright notice, conditions, and disclaimer in documentation or accompanying materials.
Do not use the Django name or contributor names to endorse or promote derived products without prior written permission.
Retain LICENSE.python alongside the bounded snapshot evidence to avoid under-compliance with upstream Python-derived-code notice requirements.

quality_gates.secret_scan: private-key, GitHub token, OpenAI-like key, AWS access key, JWT-like bearer token patterns
quality_gates.privacy_scan: email-address and obvious credential-literal heuristics; fail closed on hits
